verdict.rationale: Activepieces offers a large prebuilt connector catalog of about 760+ apps ('pieces'). They are free on every plan, cloud or self-hosted, and usable in both flows and agents. That falls well short of the 'thousands of apps' in the story, and the evidence never says whether these pieces are maintained by Activepieces or contributed by the community. missing for 10: catalog scale in the thousands, evidence that integrations are vendor-maintained, independent corroboration of connector quality and coverage.
